title: Search rollout choices
subtitle: Pick an option for each decision, then press Copy my decisions and paste the result back.

blocks.title: Why now
blocks.text: The new index is ready; these choices decide how it reaches users.

sections.title: Decisions
sections.intro: The recommended option is preselected. Your picks are saved in this browser.

items.title: Who sees the new search first
items.description: This decides how many people get the new search on day one, and how fast we can switch it off if results look wrong.
items.question: How should the rollout start?
options: Behind a flag for 10% of users
items.recommended: Behind a flag for 10% of users
items.why: A small group is enough to show problems early, and the flag turns the new search off in seconds without a deploy.
items.technical: The flag `search_v2` is read on every request and assigns a user to a bucket by user id, so the same people keep seeing the new search between visits.

items.title: What happens to the old search
items.description: Some clients still call the old search address. Removing it frees us from maintaining two searches but breaks any client that has not moved yet.
items.question: Keep the old search endpoint?
items.why: Two weeks gives the slowest client teams time to switch, and keeping it costs almost nothing.
